**Download `Teleprompter.dmg` below**, open it, and drag Teleprompter into Applications.

Works on macOS 14 Sonoma or newer, on Apple Silicon and Intel Macs.

**First time opening:** this app isn't signed by Apple, so macOS will warn you. Right-click (or Control-click) Teleprompter in Applications and choose **Open**, then click **Open** again. If that doesn't work, go to **System Settings › Privacy & Security** and click **Open Anyway**.

Teleprompter lives in the menu bar (the icon with lines of text). Scripts stay on your Mac. No accounts, no internet, no tracking.
